description: Decode GeoNames vocabulary used by the other tools: topic feature_classes lists the 9 one-letter classes; topic feature_codes lists the 684 feature codes with names and definitions, filterable by class and text; topic postal_countries lists the 122 countries with postal-code data and each one's code range and count. feature_classes and feature_codes are bundled and spend no credits; postal_countries costs 1 GeoNames credit a day (cached).

featureClass.description: Topic feature_codes only: keep the codes of this one-letter class (A, H, L, P, R, S, T, U, V). Case-insensitive.

geonamesUsername.description: Topic postal_countries only, and only when the list is not already cached: your own GeoNames username, so the call spends that account's credit instead of the server's. The account needs free web services enabled on its geonames.org account page.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, 1 to 700. Default 100.

nameContains.description: Keep only entries whose code, name, or description contains every word of this text as a substring (port also matches airport), ignoring case, accents, and punctuation.

offset.description: Entries to skip before the first one returned, for paging. Default 0.

topic.description: Vocabulary to list: feature_classes (the 9 one-letter classes), feature_codes (the 684 codes), or postal_countries (countries with postal-code data). Case-insensitive.

name: geonames_list_reference

entries.description: Entries on this page, in GeoNames order.

code.description: Feature class letter, feature code without its class prefix (PPLC), or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

description.description: The class's category and code count, or GeoNames' definition of the feature code. Absent where GeoNames gives none.

featureClass.description: Topic feature_codes: the class the code belongs to.

maxPostalCode.description: Topic postal_countries: the highest postal code or prefix GeoNames holds.

minPostalCode.description: Topic postal_countries: the lowest postal code or prefix GeoNames holds.

name.description: GeoNames' label: the class label, the feature code's name, or the country name.

postalCodeCount.description: Topic postal_countries: how many postal codes GeoNames holds for the country.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `filter_not_applicable`: featureClass was given with a topic other than feature_codes. `username_required`: Neither geonamesUsername nor the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME supplies a GeoNames account. `caller_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the caller-supplied geonamesUsername (unknown user, or free web services not enabled). `server_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME. `quota_exhausted`: GeoNames reported the account's hourly, daily, or weekly credit limit spent, or this server's pacer for the account shed the call. `upstream_rejected_parameter`: GeoNames rejected a value the schema let through; the message carries its text. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the offset is past the end, or more pages remain.

totalCount.description: Entries matching the topic and filters, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more entries remain past this page.

title: GeoNames reference vocabulary
